Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Methods

- [`Cm`](#cm): Converts this number of centimetres to points.
- [`In`](#in): Converts this number to points, in the given unit.
- [`Inches`](#inches): Converts this number of inches to points.
- [`Mm`](#mm): Converts this number of millimetres to points.
- [`Points`](#points): Interprets this number as points (1/72 inch) - the identity conversion.
